g.text: Methodology: Epoch AI data centers documentation — cumulative per-site chip counts, step-summed

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: Note: Units are counted, not performance-weighted: one Trainium2 and one B300 each count as one accelerator, though they differ several-

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: fold in throughput. Use the compute chart for capacity. Only 16 of 219 chip records are company disclosures; the rest are Epoch

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: estimates. Chip detail exists for only a subset of sites, so this understates total deployment and is not comparable in level with

text.style: fill: #6b7280; font: italic 8.4px 'DejaVu Sans', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', sans-serif; text-anchor: start

g.text: the compute chart. Right of the dashed line is planned deployment.
